title.suggested: Tom Allen gives betting odds on the New Orleans fights

summary.suggested: In the St. Louis Globe-Democrat's survey of betting on the September 1892 New Orleans fights, Tom Allen, "the heavy-weight champion," quoted 7 to 4 on Sullivan over Corbett, 5-4 McAuliffe and 3-1 Dixon.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, August 21, 1892, page 29 (same page as 855).

facts.fact: Allen quoted betting odds of 7 to 4 on Sullivan over Corbett, 5-4 on McAuliffe over Myer and 3-1 on Dixon over Skelly for the September 1892 New Orleans fights

notes: Second half of the article in 855 (same page, same date); consider linking or merging. Allen is one line among dozens, so focus is passing. The current title's 'Heavyweight Champion Assessment' is misleading.
